description: Minecraft client side mod that adds some Quality of Life changes to OG-Network's RPG-SMP mode.

mods.name: OG-Network QOL
mods.description: A client-side QOL mod for OG Network.

releases.notes:
# Additions:
- OakHaven Armor Flight Tracker: When in OakHaven, show a timer with the cooldown and flight time left for the OakHaven armor set.
- OakHaven Price Tooltips: OakHaven items now have a tooltip showing the price to which they can be sold to NPCs for Tokens.
- OakHaven Quest Tracker: When in OakHaven, show a menu with the current given quest and its task, counting how much of it is left to be completed.
- Quest Tracker: When anywhere but OakHaven, show a menu with the current given quests and its task, counting how much of it is left to be completed.
- Theoretical Sell Price: It was a default feature inside Price Tooltips, but it is not split into its own feature, so it can be toggled on or off.
- Rune Success Visualizer: On all Runes, a new bar appears at the bottom of the item that represents the chance of success. The dot from the Rune Level Visualizer was moved to the top right side of the item.

# Improved:
- The Server Announcement Remover was reworked so the player can select which kind of message sent by the server gets removed or not.
- The same kind of outline used on the HUD elements use to facilitate reading it.
- Rune Level Visualizer now puts a purple dot on overcapped Runes.
- The Server Announcements feature was renamed to Server Messages, and now also includes the message that gets sent when you hit a player, saying that PvP is disabled, the new Black Friday Sale message, and the Rules and ToS message that appears when you join the server. The Crate messages can now be disabled, as well as the RPG Chatgames.

# Fixed:
- Guardian Protector was marked as Celestial, when it is an Omni Rune.
- Coup De Grace not being recolored, and also not having a + when enhanced to level 2 or higher.

releases.notes:
- Added a Hud menu to move around features of the mod that appear on screen.
- Added Enchantment Color Fix: Colors the names of enchantments based on their Rune type.
- Added Enhanced Enchantment Indicator: Adds a '+' at the beginning of an enchantment of its level exceeds the maximum possible for that Rune. A '+' is added for every extra level.
- Added Overcapped Enchantment Fix: Fixes the broken text on enchantments that go above the vanilla meximum level.
- Added Convert Roman Numerals: Converts the roman numerals on enchantments to arabic numerals.
- Added Chat Message Color Remover: Recolors any message in chat to be plain white.
- Added Chat Name Color Remover: Recolors any name to appear white.
- Added Chat Rank Remover: Removes all ranks from chat.
- Added Chat Tag Remover: Removes all tags from chat.
- Added Real Name Display: Removes the custom names that player can set in chat.
- Added Server Announcements Remover: Removes the automatic server messages entirely.
- Added Chat Games Tracker: Adds a text with a countdown until the next RPG ChatGames will 
- Added Seismic Slam Tracker: Adds a text that shows the cooldown of Seismic Slam.

- Fixed Vote Tracker: Renamed the first website to Minecraft-MP.
- Fixed Rune Type Visualizer:
  - Hovering an item over it will now render it on top of the Rune instead if bellow.
  - Picking up a Rune in an inventory will not make it lose its custom texture.

- Improved the Mod Menu interface by adding categories for settings.
- Improved Price Tooltips: It now states the possible price of an item if it gets uncrafted (for example, how a diamond block, that you can not usually sell, can be sold by uncrafting it). Holding Shift while hovering the item will state what needs to be done for the item to be sold.
- Improved Rune Type Visualizer: It now supports Rare and Legendary runes. Common Runes are not supported, since the texture would look basically the same as the regular paper.
